notes: Technical report (arXiv:2401.06066), not a system card. No dedicated safety section and no safety, refusal, jailbreak, toxicity, bias, honesty, hallucination, or dangerous-capability numeric results—evalResults left empty. Open LLM Leaderboard is said to include TruthfulQA, but only an average chart (Figure 1) is shown with no TruthfulQA numbers in the text layer. Section 6 "Alignment" is SFT for a chat model (math/code/writing/QA), not safety alignment—does not cover topics. Expert-specialization analysis is architecture research, not safety interpretability. Skipped all capability tables (Tables 1–6 and Figure 1/7): Pile, HellaSwag, PIQA, ARC, RACE, DROP, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, TriviaQA, NaturalQuestions, MMLU, WinoGrande, CLUEWSC, CEval, CMMLU, CHID, BBH, and Open LLM Leaderboard averages. Seed-linked deepseek-ai/deepseek-moe-16b-chat covered; base uses checkpoint id deepseek-ai/deepseek-moe-16b-base. DeepSeekMoE 2B and 145B covered as rawModelName (no seed ids). Paper announces public release without a license name or calendar release date; arXiv date is publication, not releaseDate. Layout pdftotext splits many figure pages (null/garbled text); pageCount 33 from PDF page count; printed page numbers used for sources.
